info.title: Tomix.Cli
info.description: tx - open-source CLI for inspecting, validating, querying, testing, and deploying tabular semantic models (Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Analysis Services).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: tx - inspect, validate, query, test, and deploy tabular semantic models

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to the semantic model: a TMDL folder, a .bim file, or a model folder

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Format for data written to stdout: text (default), json, csv, tmsl (alias: bim), or tmdl. Availability varies by command. [default: text]

options.name: --error-format
options.description: Format for messages written to stderr: text (default) or json. Unrecognized values fall back to text.

options.name: --server
options.description: Workspace to connect to: a name, a powerbi:// or asazure:// endpoint, or a local address

options.name: --database
options.description: Name of the semantic model to use on the workspace

options.name: --auth
options.description: How to authenticate: auto, interactive, spn, or managed-identity (default: auto)

options.name: --recent
options.description: Pick a model from the recently used list: no value opens a picker, a number picks that entry (1 is the most recent).

options.name: --debug
options.description: Show the full stack trace on stderr when an unexpected error occurs [default: False]

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Never prompt for input. When required input is missing, fail with an error saying what to provide. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts for destructive operations [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress non-essential output (spinners, progress, hints). Errors and data still print. [default: False]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Create a new object in the model

options.name: --type
options.description: Type of object to create. Supported values: Table, CalcTable, CalcGroup, Measure, CalcColumn, DataColumn, Hierarchy, Level, Calendar, CalcItem, KPI, Partition, MPartition, EntityPartition, PolicyRangePartition, Expression, Function, Perspective, Culture, ProviderDataSource, StructuredDataSource, Role, TablePermission, Member, Relationship. Data sources always require -t (no path keyword infers them).

options.name: -i
options.description: Compatibility form of --expression / --set: an unpaired -i is the new object's value; pair each -q with a following -i to set a property. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: -q
options.description: Compatibility form of --set: property name to set on the newly-created object; pair each -q with a following -i value. Repeatable.

options.name: --expression
options.description: Expression or value for the new object. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: --set
options.description: Set a property on the new object: name=value, e.g. --set formatString="#,0". Repeatable. Names can use dotted paths, bracket indexers, or a DisplayName.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read the expression from this file

options.name: --if-not-exists
options.description: Do nothing and exit 0 when the object already exists [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Write the model even though validation reports errors [default: False]

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Allow --save-to to overwrite an existing target [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview: show the change without saving, staging, or syncing [default: False]

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Write the saved model to this path instead of its source (implies --save)

options.name: --serialization
options.description: How the model is written: tmdl or bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

options.name: --save
options.description: Write this command's change back to the model's source. Cannot be combined with --revert or --stage. [default: False]

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

options.name: --mode
options.description: Storage mode for the partition: Import, DirectQuery, Dual, DirectLake, Push, or Default.

options.name: --source
options.description: Provider name for a ProviderDataSource (e.g. System.Data.SqlClient).

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Server/endpoint address for a data source connection.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: The connection string used by a ProviderDataSource.

options.name: --source-table
options.description: Source entity/table name for an EntityPartition.

options.name: --source-database
options.description: Source database name for a data source connection (Provider/Structured data sources).

options.name: --source-schema
options.description: Source schema name for an EntityPartition.

options.name: --partition-expression
options.description: The M or DAX expression defining the partition's source.

options.name: --columns
options.description: Comma-separated column names to create on a new table (Table type only).

options.name: --source-type
options.description: Connection protocol for a StructuredDataSource (e.g. tds).

options.name: --range-start
options.description: Refresh-policy range start for a PolicyRangePartition (yyyy-MM-dd).

options.name: --range-end
options.description: Refresh-policy range end for a PolicyRangePartition (yyyy-MM-dd).

options.name: --range-granularity
options.description: Refresh-policy range granularity for a PolicyRangePartition: Day (default), Month, Quarter, Year.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Where to create the object, slash-separated: 'Sales/Revenue', 'Products', 'Admin'. DAX form also accepted: "'Sales'[Revenue]". Combine with -t. For relationships, use 'Sales[Key]->Product[Key]' (many side first).

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Set active connection (workspace, local path, or PBI Desktop). No args = show current. --recent = reconnect to a recently used model.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Enable workspace mode: mirror saves between the primary source and a secondary target. Primary remote -> pass a local folder or .bim file. Primary local -> pass <server> <database>. Pass -w with no value to pick the target workspace and model interactively.

options.name: --local
options.description: Attach to a Power BI Desktop instance running on this machine (Windows only) [default: False]

options.name: --remote
options.description: Pick a workspace and semantic model interactively from your Power BI tenant (requires a TTY; sign in first with 'tx auth login'). [default: False]

options.name: --profile
options.description: Connect through this saved profile (list them with 'tx profile list')

options.name: --clear
options.description: Forget the active connection [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow workspace mode to initialize over a folder that already has content. [default: False]

options.name: --workspace-format
options.description: How a local workspace is stored on disk (tmdl or bim); detected from the path when omitted.

options.name: --workspace-auth
options.description: How to authenticate the remote side of workspace mode. Defaults to --auth when set, otherwise auto.

arguments.name: SERVER
arguments.description: Workspace name, endpoint, or local model path; combine with --local for Power BI Desktop.

arguments.name: DATABASE
arguments.description: Semantic model name (omit on a TTY to pick from the workspace's models).

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy a semantic model to a workspace

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deploy through a saved profile for this run only; see 'tx profile list' and 'tx profile set'

options.name: --create-only
options.description: Create the target model only if it does not exist yet; fail when it does [default: False]

options.name: --xmla
options.description: Write the deployment as a TMSL script to this file instead of deploying. Pass '-' to write to stdout.

options.name: --skip-bpa
options.description: Skip the BPA gate check for this deploy. [default: False]

options.name: --fix-bpa
options.description: Apply BPA rule fixes to the model before deploying, where a rule provides one [default: False]

options.name: --bpa-rules
options.description: Additional BPA rule files to enforce for this deploy, alongside the built-in ruleset.

options.name: --bpa-fail-on
options.description: Severity threshold for the BPA gate: error (default) or warning. Applies before the deploy and again after --fix-bpa fixes. Rules that cannot be evaluated count as error-severity findings

options.name: --force
options.description: Force deployment, bypassing validation checks [default: False]

options.name: --ci
options.description: Print CI log-group commands to stderr for the given system: vsts or github

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview what would change on the remote target without deploying [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-connections
options.description: Overwrite the target's data sources (default: keep the target's connection strings) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-partitions
options.description: Overwrite the target's table partitions (default: keep the target's partitions and processed data) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-policy-partitions
options.description: With --deploy-partitions: also overwrite incremental-refresh policy partitions, discarding processed data (default: keep them) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-shared-expressions
options.description: Overwrite the target's shared expressions / M parameters (default: keep the target's values) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-roles
options.description: Overwrite the target's security roles (default: keep the target's roles) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-role-members
options.description: With --deploy-roles: also overwrite role members (default: keep the target's members) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-full
options.description: Overwrite everything, including incremental-refresh partitions (cannot be combined with other --deploy-* flags) [default: False]

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description: Optional path to the model to deploy; defaults to the active connection
